name: dual_horizon_v2
scaling: Freeze first-five and full-100 mean squared errors of the shared initialization on ALL TRAIN trajectories. No validation scaling, no online moving denominator, no teacher predictions in the loss.
selection: All 100 validation trajectories, training grid 256, full 100-step free rollout. Minimize max(first5_MSE/FNO_first5_MSE, full100_MSE/FNO_full100_MSE), including epoch zero. Strict ratio below one means both validation MSEs beat original FNO. Report final and selected on native-grid readouts; native evaluation cannot change selection.
compute_caveat: 40 additional full-trajectory epochs with a fresh Adam and cosine schedule.
confirmation: A validation dual win is preliminary. Lock one candidate per equation before independent confirmation; do not retune against original test or a revealed confirmation set. Multiple training seeds remain necessary for an algorithm-level claim.
